title: Thai Lemongrass Chicken Braised Dish
description: A delicious and aromatic Thai-inspired braised dish made with lemongrass, chicken, and a mixture of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary and sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add lemongrass and sauté for 1 minute.
Add carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and soy sauce.
Return chicken to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover and transfer to the oven and braise for 30 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with chopped lemongrass and fresh cilantro.
